OmaStats 1.2 adds optional utilization colors to the bar and lets an idle AMD GPU runtime-suspend.

- Optional utilization colors grade CPU, GPU and memory bar figures, rings and mini graphs, plus disk-capacity figures and rings: low below 25%, normal 25–59%, warning 60–84% and critical at 85% and above. They are off by default and can be turned on under Settings → General.
- The default green, blue, orange and red shades adapt to light and dark bars. Each grade accepts a custom `#RRGGBB` color that stays fixed across themes. Clear a field to return to the theme-aware default.
- Sampling no longer keeps an idle AMD GPU awake. On an AMD card that can runtime-suspend, load, clock, power and temperatures are read once per autosuspend delay (about six seconds by default), so the card can still sleep when idle. Both the Rust and Python samplers do this.

Both bundled binaries are rebuilt twice in CI, compared byte-for-byte with the committed executables, and covered by checksums and GitHub build attestations.

The normal plugin installation remains:

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omastats.git --enable
```

Thanks to @jsonMartin for the utilization colors in #11 and @dieuwedeboer for the AMD runtime-suspend fix in #10.
